title: Famous catchphrases and who says them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?phrase WHERE { VALUES ?item { curated famous qids } ?item wdt:P6251 ?phrase }

catchphrase.match: Match each famous name to its catchphrase.

rows.label: Mr. T
rows.hook: is a mohawked tough guy draped in gold chains who drove a van in an action team series

rows.label: Owen Wilson
rows.hook: is a laid-back actor with a famously crooked nose who starred in Zoolander and Wedding Crashers

rows.label: Martha Stewart
rows.hook: built a lifestyle empire around cooking, crafts and home decorating

rows.label: Stan Lee
rows.description: American comic book writer, editor, publisher, and producer (1922–2018)
rows.hook: co-created Spider-Man and the Hulk and made cameo appearances in Marvel movies

rows.label: The X-Files
rows.hook: follows two FBI agents, Mulder and Scully, who investigate paranormal cases

rows.label: Survivor
rows.description: American version of the international Survivor reality competition television franchise
rows.hook: strands contestants on a remote island where they vote one another out

rows.label: Wheel of Fortune
rows.catchphrase: I’d like to buy a vowel!
rows.hook: has contestants spin a giant prize carousel and guess letters to solve word puzzles

rows.label: Jerry Maguire
rows.hook: stars Tom Cruise as a sports agent who loses his job after writing a mission statement

rows.label: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
rows.hook: are four sewer-dwelling brothers named after Renaissance artists who love pizza

rows.label: Bugs Bunny
rows.hook: is a wisecracking cartoon rabbit who munches carrots and outwits Elmer Fudd

rows.label: Groucho Marx
rows.catchphrase: Say the secret word and win $100!
rows.hook: was a wisecracking comedian with a greasepaint mustache who hosted the quiz show You Bet Your Life

rows.label: Sheldon Cooper
rows.description: fictional character in The Big Bang Theory and Young Sheldon
rows.hook: is a genius physicist who knocks three times and guards his spot on the couch

rows.label: Santa Claus
rows.description: legendary figure said to deliver gifts to people on Christmas Eve
rows.hook: rides a sleigh pulled by reindeer and slides down chimneys to deliver presents

rows.label: Vito Corleone
rows.catchphrase: I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse
rows.description: fictional character from Mario Puzo's 1969 novel The Godfather
rows.hook: is the soft-spoken mafia don played by Marlon Brando in a classic crime film

rows.label: Lightning McQueen
rows.description: fictional character from the Cars franchise
rows.hook: is a hotshot red race car who learns humility in Radiator Springs

rows.label: SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.description: main character from the animated television show SpongeBob SquarePants
rows.hook: is a cheerful fry cook who lives in a pineapple under the sea

rows.label: Uncle Sam
rows.description: personification of the United States of America and its government
rows.hook: is a bearded figure in a star-spangled top hat seen on recruiting posters

rows.label: Walter Cronkite
rows.catchphrase: And that's the way it is.
rows.hook: anchored the CBS Evening News and was once called the most trusted man in America

rows.label: Ed McMahon
rows.description: American announcer, game show host, actor, and spokesman (1923-2009)
rows.hook: was the booming-voiced sidekick on a long-running late-night talk show

rows.label: Spock
rows.hook: is the pointy-eared, logical half-Vulcan science officer of the starship Enterprise

rows.label: Bart Simpson
rows.hook: is a spiky-haired, skateboarding troublemaker who prank calls Moe's Tavern

rows.label: Homer Simpson
rows.hook: is a donut-loving, beer-drinking safety inspector at a nuclear plant

rows.label: David Frost
rows.description: British television host, journalist, comedian and writer (1939–2013)

rows.label: Eric Cartman
rows.hook: is a bratty, hat-wearing fourth grader with a sharp tongue and a love of Cheesy Poofs

rows.label: Fonzie
rows.hook: is a leather-jacketed greaser who can start a jukebox with a thump

rows.label: Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.description: video game character from the eponymous video game franchise
rows.hook: is a blue speedster who collects golden rings and battles Doctor Eggman

rows.label: Tim Gunn
rows.hook: is the mentor on the fashion design competition show Project Runway

rows.label: Jessica Rabbit
rows.catchphrase: I'm not bad. I'm just drawn that way.
rows.description: fictional character from the novel Who Censored Roger Rabbit? and its film adaptation Who Framed Roger Rabbit
rows.hook: is a red-haired femme fatale singer in a film mixing live action and cartoons

rows.label: Alfred E. Neuman
rows.hook: is a gap-toothed, freckled boy whose face has graced a satirical humor magazine

rows.label: Terminator

rows.hook: is a relentless time-traveling killer robot sent from the future

rows.label: Scooby-Doo
rows.hook: is a cowardly talking Great Dane who solves mysteries from a van full of teens

rows.label: Velma Dinkley
rows.description: fictional character from the Scooby-Doo universe
rows.hook: is the bespectacled brains of a mystery-solving gang who wears an orange turtleneck

rows.label: Little Britain
rows.hook: is a sketch show packed with recurring characters like Vicky Pollard and Lou and Andy

rows.label: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
rows.hook: has contestants climb a money ladder using lifelines like phone a friend

rows.label: Buzz Lightyear
rows.hook: is a space ranger action figure who believes he can really fly

rows.label: Porky Pig
rows.hook: is a stuttering, bow-tied cartoon oinker who signs off Looney Tunes shorts

rows.label: Rick Sanchez

rows.label: Dalek

rows.label: Emmett Brown
